summary: Mrs. Tawil discusses how to maintain one's inner peace and connection to Hashem when dealing with difficult external situations. She uses personal examples and the story of Nachshon Wachsman to explain how defining one's own boundaries and praying to Hashem allows us to walk hand-in-hand with Him instead of becoming reactive or trying to control others.
questions: How can I keep my peace when someone is invading my space?
Why do we sometimes feel like our prayers are not being answered?
How do I stop trying to control or please other people?
What does it mean to walk hand-in-hand with Hashem?
